breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The known inconsistency was the contradictory instruction to use both half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack and gamma-centered k-points. The generated specification keeps only 'automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift' and does not repeat the gamma-centered requirement, matching the ground truth correction.
